name: io.github.ianderso/dpla-catalog-mcp
title: DPLA Catalog
description: Search the Digital Public Library of America and reach the holding institution's record and page images.

environmentVariables.name: DPLA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your DPLA API key: 32 letters, digits or hyphens. Free; request it with POST https://api.dp.la/v2/api_key/YOUR_EMAIL and it arrives by email.

environmentVariables.name: DPLA_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: DPLA_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between the start of one request to DPLA and the next.
